jiuma-free-image-edit 1.0.2

- Updated the skill description to include English, improving international clarity.
- No functional or code changes detected; documentation only.
- Enhanced multilingual support in the SKILL.md description section.

**新增扫码登录，超额后可解锁更多免费次数：**

- 添加扫码登录功能，当免费编辑次数用尽时，支持扫码注册/登录九马平台获取API密钥，无需升级也可继续免费使用（参见LOGIN.md与login.py）
- 更新使用说明和故障排除，详细说明登录流程以及免费额度用尽后的操作方法
- 新增LOGIN.md和相关login.py、utils.py文件
- 强调仅在出现FreeApiLimit错误时需扫码登录，操作流程更简洁
- 原有图片编辑与融合功能保持不变

Initial release of jiuma-free-image-edit.

- Provides free image editing using the 九马AI API with support for up to 3 image fusion and editing tasks.
- Allows editing images by text prompts, supporting both local image files and remote URLs.
- Includes task submission and status checking via command line and OpenClaw environments.
- Documents supported image formats, error handling, tips for prompt engineering, and best practices.
- No API key required; free to use with queueing at peak times.
- Detailed usage instructions and troubleshooting included.
